style: Hand-painted 2D art deco midnight casino interiors; midnight teal, antique brass, gold light, burgundy and plum. Square, straight-on, no people, UI, lettering, watermark, isometric or 3D render.

images.prompt: High Limit Slots: exclusive row of two grand jewel-inlaid brass slot cabinets, emerald velvet stools, dark teal fan-pattern wallpaper, warm gold sconces.
Poker Room: a large oval emerald felt poker table with small stacks of chips, plum tufted chairs, walnut panels, intimate brass pendant lamps.
Fine Dining: intimate restaurant with elegantly set round tables, white linen, gold-rimmed china, burgundy banquettes, candlelight and art deco wall lamps.
Grand Stage: luxurious intimate theatre stage, sweeping plum velvet curtains, a grand piano under warm amber spotlights, brass art deco proscenium, emerald seats.
Private Gaming Salon: secluded opulent gaming salon, single emerald card table, luxurious plum armchairs, fireplace, discreet brass wall lamps and dark walnut privacy doors.
Luxury Hotel: grand intimate hotel reception interior with an ornate emerald and brass reception desk, luggage trolley, dramatic art deco chandelier, marble floor, plush burgundy seating.
Spa & Wellness: tranquil luxury spa interior with a small teal reflecting pool, emerald tiles, brass details, neatly folded towels, warm candles, lounge chairs and palms.
Sky Bar: sophisticated rooftop cocktail bar, polished walnut and brass counter, plum bar chairs, large glass windows revealing a midnight city skyline, warm amber hanging lamps.
Convention Hall: grand art deco conference hall with rows of elegant emerald chairs, central aisle to a small podium, brass arches, chandeliers and rich dark wood walls.
Penthouse Club: luxurious private penthouse lounge, sculptural plum velvet sofas, marble champagne table, warm brass chandelier, dark emerald walls and panoramic midnight city windows.
